title: Review of ringed active-nematic rods (SIBMD): replicated on seed 6 with chis=0; the ring (1.46) and the motility (3.0 BL) both sit at their gates; Weak
summary: I ran world.py on seed 6 and the same file with WORLD_P chis=0 on seed 6 (200 frames, t=1000). Rods nucleate from the noisy uniform state, divide and colonize the domain (labkit: 23 persistent splits, generation 4, merge/split 0.24; 30 rods at the end) and move (42 long-lived tracks >= 1 body length, max 3.0 BL). The surfactant forms an interface ring: aggregate rim/core 1.46, rim/outside 2.12, 77/116 individuals membrane-like. With chis=0 (the dynamics are otherwise bit-identical, the surfactant being passive) it is a diffuse fill: rim/core 0.93, 0/116.

verdicts.limitation: The ring is a passive adsorbed tracer (no back-reaction), and its aggregate rim/core is 1.46 on this seed (the author has 1.38-1.63), so B is at the gate. Motility reaches exactly 3.0 body lengths at best and is not dt-converged (parent), so M is at its gate too. I did not verify that one track shows all four capabilities together.
